We are pleased to confirm that Delta Power plc has engaged Lab Firm LLP to act on a commercial litigation. Responsibility for the matter rests with Matthias Adeyemi, who may be contacted at any time about its progress.

Our London office will staff the matter. Fees will be billed periodically on the basis of time spent, in accordance with our standard terms.

Yours faithfully,

Lab Firm LLP
